specimen.title: Chart kit
specimen.intro: Every figure component in every state, drawn from synthetic data. This page exists only on the development server.
specimen.barsCaption: Tool calls by tool, largest first.
specimen.columnsCaption: Sessions per day; series stack with a gap between them.
specimen.linesCaption: Tokens per day; a break in a line was not reported.

specimen.multiplesCaption: Sessions per day for each harness, all on the same scale.

specimen.lanesCaption: Each agent's work in one day; the lunch break is compressed.
specimen.lanesDenseCaption: Six agents over three days; nights are compressed into breaks.
specimen.stripsCaption: Each session's state over an afternoon.
specimen.heatmapCaption: Tool calls by weekday and hour.
specimen.heatmapDenseCaption: Calls of sixteen tools by hour.
specimen.treeCaption: A session and the agents it started, by how each link is known.
